findings.summary: toCell's `val instanceof Date` branch is unreachable in the real (HTTP) data path, giving a false impression that Date objects are handled end-to-end
findings.evidence: packages/sheets/src/store/readonly.ts:33 checks `val instanceof Date`, but the only real caller (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/datasource-view.tsx:108) passes rows that arrived over HTTP/JSON from the Nest controller (packages/backend/src/datasource/datasource.controller.ts:144 → executeQuery). JSON.stringify on the server response already turns any Date into an ISO string before the frontend ever sees it, and the new datasource.service.ts change additionally removes Date parsing for DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ entirely (raw string from custom type parser). So in production `val` is never actually a Date instance when toCell runs in the frontend; only the in-process e2e test (which calls the service directly, bypassing HTTP) could hit that branch. Not a crash, but the fix for 'Date shifts by timezone' data loss is masked by a branch that can't fire on the real path — worth confirming the intended fix path is the raw-text type parser (which it is) rather than relying on toCell's Date handling.

findings.summary: RAW_TEXT_OIDS only covers DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ; date/timestamp *array* oids (e.g. _date, _timestamp, _timestamptz) still go through the default parser and will produce Date objects (subject to the original timezone-shift bug) inside array values
findings.evidence: packages/backend/src/datasource/datasource.service.ts:21-25 builds RAW_TEXT_OIDS from types.builtins.DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ scalar OIDs only; array OIDs are separate builtins (not enumerated here), so a query selecting a date[] or timestamptz[] column would still hit getDefaultParser and get an array of JS Date objects subject to the timezone-shift issue the change is trying to fix.
searchedFor: types.builtins array oid constants in pg-types
grep for _DATE/_TIMESTAMP array oid handling in datasource.service.ts

findings.summary: toCell() JSON.stringifies binary (bytea) values into a decimal-array representation, expanding payload size ~4-5x versus raw bytes; combined with the 10,000-row cap but no per-row/column size limit, a user with valid datasource credentials could SELECT a large bytea column to inflate backend/frontend memory and response size beyond the original blob size.
findings.evidence: toCell(val) does `JSON.stringify(val)` for any object, including Node Buffer instances returned for bytea columns, producing `{"type":"Buffer","data":[..]}` which is several times larger than the underlying binary; executeQuery() in datasource.service.ts has no per-column/row byte-size cap, only a MAX_ROWS=10_000 row cap and a 30s statement_timeout, so a large blob column can still be pulled into memory and serialized.

findings.summary: No new authorization, injection, or crypto issues were found in the reviewed hunks; the added `SET TimeZone`/`SET DateStyle` statements and the custom OID type-parser use only hardcoded literals (no interpolated user input), and ownership checks (findRaw in the controller) remain unchanged and are still invoked before executeQuery/testConnection.

docs/design/sheets/datasource.md documents 'Query Execution' (statement_timeout + LIMIT wrapping) and lists 'No column type mapping — all values are displayed as strings' as a current limitation, but the diff changes query-execution behavior (adds SET TimeZone/DateStyle, overrides the pg type parser for DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ so those come back as raw text instead of JS Date) without updating the design doc to reflect the new behavior or partially resolving that limitation.

New exported toCell() function (packages/sheets/src/store/readonly.ts) has zero direct unit tests in the sheets package's own test suite; its `instanceof Date` branch is never exercised by any test in the repo.
findings.evidence: packages/sheets has no readonly*.spec.ts/test.ts covering ReadOnlyStore or toCell (checked packages/sheets/**/*.spec.ts and *.test.ts glob results, and grepped 'ReadOnlyStore' in packages/sheets/test with no matches). The only exercise of toCell is indirectly via packages/backend/test/database.e2e-spec.ts, which calls toCell() directly against real Postgres query results. But the datasource service's custom type parser (datasource.service.ts) converts every date/timestamp OID (DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMPTZ) to a raw string before it reaches toCell, and the frontend's only other call site (datasource-view.tsx line ~108: storeRef.current.loadQueryResults) receives values that already passed through JSON serialization over HTTP (Dates become strings before toCell runs client-side). So the `val instanceof Date` branch in toCell is effectively unreachable in the app and is untested anywhere. If that branch has a bug, no test in any enforced lane (including the sheets vitest lane) would catch it.

findings.summary: Duplicate test with the identical name 'queries real tables with rows' now exists twice in database.e2e-spec.ts: the newly added version (using toCell-based assertions) was inserted before the pre-existing, unmodified original test (line 309) rather than replacing it, leaving two near-identical tests exercising the same _test_products table/CRUD flow.
findings.evidence: The diff adds a full new `it('queries real tables with rows', ...)` block, but the original test of the same name and nearly identical body (CREATE TABLE _test_products, insert rows, query, assert raw object equality) remains unchanged further down in the file (visible at line 309 in the post-diff file). This is redundant coverage/copy-paste that should have replaced or removed the old version; it doesn't invalidate either test but signals the new integration test may have been meant to supersede the old one.

verdict.reason: toCell (packages/sheets/src/store/readonly.ts:32-36) has three branches; only the `val instanceof Date` branch converts via toISOString(). Searching the whole repo for call sites of toCell turns up exactly two: the definition/call inside readonly.ts itself and packages/backend/test/database.e2e-spec.ts:175,301. That e2e test's DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ rows are pre-converted to raw text by datasourceTypeParser in packages/backend/src/datasource/datasource.service.ts:19-25,34-36 before reaching toCell, so even that test never passes a real Date instance into toCell. No file in packages/sheets/test, packages/sheets/src/**/__tests__, packages/frontend tests, or anywhere else grepped for `toCell(new Date`, `toISOString`, `ReadOnlyStore`, or `loadQueryResults` constructs a Date and feeds it through toCell/loadQueryResults. I could not find a counterexample despite checking sheets test dirs, backend e2e specs, frontend test dirs, and the pg type-parser wiring, but I cannot rule out an indirect exercise I haven't thought of (e.g. some other datasource path or a future OID mapping), so confidence is kept low given the absence-claim nature and the difficulty of proving a true negative exhaustively.
